name: Fast team with an architecture
description: The fast team inside a lasting architecture. When the project has none yet, an Architect designs its modules, the rules for which may use which, and the contracts, and you approve them once. Every run after that builds inside it, and Verify rejects imports that break the rules.

steps.name: Architect
steps.purpose: Designs the modules, which may use which, and the contracts the project keeps; runs only while the project has no architecture.

steps.name: Reviewer
steps.purpose: Reads only the changes, with a fresh mind, and sends real problems back to the Builder once.
